players.product: Microchannel liquid cold plates, liquid-cooling modules and high-performance thermal interface materials (graphene pads, liquid metal) for AI servers, plus vapor chambers, heat pipes and air-cooling modules

quarterly_data.quarter: Jones Tech half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 results (half-year report): revenue RMB 827,802,748.29, up 10.66% YoY; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 137,974,401.06, up 13.59%; net profit excluding non-recurring items RMB 132,661,064.53, up 19.96%; operating cash flow RMB 172,119,294.00, up 40.43%. Thermal materials (the only product line above 10% of revenue) RMB 80,547.81 ten-thousand, up 12.36%, gross margin 33.72% (up 2.16 points). Inventory rose to RMB 286,530,388.36 from RMB 183,635,236.09 at the start of the year, which the company attributes to stocking up for a large increase in business.

quarterly_data.quarter: Jones Tech half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: R&D and new thermal interface materials (half-year report): R&D spend RMB 47,831,796.56 in H1 2026, up 32.19%, mainly from faster R&D investment in emerging thermal products. For high-power chips the company has developed vertically oriented graphene thermal pads and liquid-metal thermal materials, which it says can meet the heat-conduction needs of GPU, ASIC and other high-power advanced-packaging chips in AI servers, switches and high-speed optical modules; in H1 it continued performance optimization, reliability validation and customer sample testing and pushed introduction at key customers.

quarterly_data.quarter: Jones Tech half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Named customers outside digital infrastructure (half-year report): in consumer electronics the company says it covers essentially all leading 3C customers and has long served its North American major customer, Samsung, Microsoft, Google, Amazon, 'customer H' and Honor; its high-performance VC wick material has completed product introduction and validation at the North American major customer and is ready for volume delivery. In smart transportation its customers include Xpeng, BYD, DJI and a global top-3 German auto-parts supplier; in clean energy it has long-term cooperation with Sungrow and supplies in batches, including to the customer's overseas manufacturing bases. The company says its customer base has widened from a single North American major customer to several leading customers.

quarterly_data.quarter: Jones Tech half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Capacity and construction (half-year report): construction in progress rose to RMB 103,188,339.93 from RMB 3,573,070.72, mainly continued investment in the Thailand plant; the Thailand plant-construction EPC project has a budget of RMB 198,567,347.20 (the THB contract converted at the period-end rate), RMB 99,305,161.25 invested to date and 50.00% progress. The Thailand subsidiary JONES TECH (Thailand) had H1 2026 revenue RMB 14,415.75 ten-thousand and net profit RMB 5,229.78 ten-thousand. The company says it has built an overseas production base centered on Thailand and is accelerating overseas capacity expansion.

players.product: VC (vapor chamber) thermal modules, thermal interface materials and liquid-cooling modules for 800G / 1.6T optical modules (connector liquid cold plates, NPO liquid cooling)

quarterly_data.quarter: Jones Tech half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Optical-module thermal business (half-year report): the company says it has built a full 'materials - components - modules - liquid cooling' thermal stack for optical modules at chip, module and system level, covering high-performance TIM, VC thermal modules and liquid cooling. In H1 2026 it kept building optical-module thermal capacity and delivery capability; VC thermal module delivery volume kept growing and its supplier position at core customers was further consolidated. It is accelerating customer introduction of high-performance TIM, integrated VC modules and new optical-module liquid-cooling products, and pushing validation and application of customized liquid-cooling products under CPO / NPO / XPO architectures as optical modules move to 800G, 1.6T and 3.2T.

quarterly_data.quarter: Jones Tech half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Connector customer win (half-year report): through the integration of Zhongshi Xunleng (acquired in 2025) the company entered the supplier system of a leading connector customer and obtained a vendor code, with some thermal products in volume delivery; for 1.6T high-speed optical modules and next-generation high-speed interconnect it is developing, validating and introducing to customers new connector liquid cold plates and NPO liquid-cooling solutions. The connector customer is not named.

quarterly_data.quarter: Jones Tech half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Named digital-infrastructure customers (half-year report): the company says its customers include 'customer H', ZTE, Ericsson, Nokia, Cisco, Coherent, Source Photonics and TE Connectivity - leading global communications-equipment and optical-communication device makers - with long-term stable relationships. Its main products in this field are TIM, EMI shielding materials, vapor chambers, heat pipes and thermal modules, used in base stations, high-speed optical modules, servers, switches, routers and SSDs.

quarterly_data.quarter: Jones Tech half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Innolight shareholding (half-year report, post-period event): the company's controlling shareholder, actual controller and their concert parties signed a share transfer agreement with Innolight to transfer 31,372,504 tradable shares, 10.47% of total share capital, by agreement; the procedures were still in progress at the report date. The company says it has a good industry-chain synergy basis with Innolight and will use its thermal-materials R&D, customized solutions and engineering delivery to develop thermal products and solutions for high-speed optical modules and other optical-communication products. No supply relationship is stated.
